verdict.rationale: Legacy-protocol support is a fair question for Google Workspace, which acts as an identity and directory platform. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a cloud LDAP endpoint, a RADIUS endpoint, or VPN and Wi-Fi authentication. The SSO and SAML items (docs-2, docs-18, docs-25) cover a different protocol and are not credited for this story.

support.subject: As an IT admin, legacy protocols still work — cloud LDAP and RADIUS endpoints serve the VPNs, Wi-Fi, and older systems that will never speak SAML
